guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Coherent optical backbone transmission
guides.concept: 以相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「相干量測」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留調變，只改 OSNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「I/Q 訊號」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「偏振解混」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：等化器需追蹤偏振混合的變化。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定纖長，只改色散模型參數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「載波回復」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coherent measurement, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat i/q signals as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around symbols and bits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Baud and bit/s connect through modulation and polarization count. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat optical signal-to-noise ratio as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around polarization demultiplexing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Equalizers must track changes in polarization mixing. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix distance and vary dispersion-model parameters. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat carrier recovery as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around nonlinear penalties, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Higher launch power can also increase nonlinear impairment. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic constellations at different laser phase-noise levels. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat modulation tradeoffs as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around otn mapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transport framing provides monitoring and carriage boundaries for clients. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model capacity/margin tradeoff from lowering modulation order. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat spectrum assignment as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mode fallback, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Mode changes require peer compatibility and service-capacity checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model capacity/margin tradeoff from lowering modulation order. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat coherent measurement as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「品質餘裕」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「模式回退」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for quality margin. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 被動光網路設備
related.why: 可移植「相干量測」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from coherent measurement; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「相干量測」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from coherent measurement; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質；「被動光網路設備」主要處理PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality; Passive optical-network equipment emphasizes pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」與「被動光網路設備」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「OSNR」的對照方法至「距離量測」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Coherent optical backbone transmission and Passive optical-network equipment flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from optical signal-to-noise ratio to ranging, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
